# Unity vs Godot 对比图谱

## 环境准备与安装需求 [BV1HFTE6rETA P1 01:26]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    U[Unity] -->|约21GB磁盘空间| DS[硬盘空间需求]
    G[Godot] -->|更小磁盘占用| DS
    DS --> Choose[根据硬盘剩余空间选择引擎]
    U --> InstallU[安装Unity]
    G --> InstallG[安装Godot]
    InstallU --> CheckU[检查硬盘空间]
    InstallG --> CheckG[检查硬盘空间]
    CheckU -->|不足| Choose
    CheckG -->|不足| Choose
```

## 启动加载时间比较 [BV1HFTE6rETA P1 01:53-02:14]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start[项目启动] --> LoadU[Unity加载]
    Start --> LoadG[Godot加载]
    LoadU --> TimeU[1分20秒]
    LoadG --> TimeG[13.5秒]
    TimeU --> RatioU[5.4倍慢于Godot]
    TimeG --> RatioG[5.4倍快于Unity]
    LoadU --> Basic[基本灯光+纹理]
    LoadG --> Basic
```

## 构建导出时间比较 [BV1HFTE6rETA P1 08:50-08:56]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    BuildStart[开始构建] --> BuildU[Unity构建]
    BuildStart --> BuildG[Godot构建]
    BuildU --> TimeU[15分钟]
    BuildG --> TimeG[2秒~2.5秒]
    TimeU --> RatioU[341倍慢于Godot]
    TimeG --> RatioG[341倍快于Unity]
    BuildU --> ExportOptU[首次导出文件大]
    BuildG --> ExportOptG[排除资源后文件小]
    ExportOptU --> SizeDiff[约20倍大小差异]
    ExportOptG --> SizeDiff
```

## 运行时帧率与资源使用 [BV1HFTE6rETA P1 10:34-12:05]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Runtime[运行时性能] --> FPSU[Unity FPS 200-300]
    Runtime --> FPSG[Godot FPS 950]
    FPSG --> HighFPS[最高630 FPS 实测]
    FPSU --> LowFPS[Unity 76% GPU 29% CPU]
    FPSG --> HighGPU[Godot 95% GPU 8% CPU]
    FPSG --> MaterialOpt[单材质优化]
    MaterialOpt --> GPUUsage[降低GPU负载]
    FPSU --> NoOpt[未做材质优化]
    GPUUsage --> PerfResult[Godot 在所有指标上优于Unity]
```

## 功能灵活性与实现方式 [BV1HFTE6rETA P1 04:07-05:46]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Feature[功能实现] --> CamFollow[摄像机跟随]
    CamFollow --> UnityCam[Unity 默认实现]
    CamFollow --> GodotCam[Godot 自定义脚本]
    Feature --> RootMotion[根运动]
    RootMotion --> UnityRM[Unity 支持根运动]
    RootMotion --> GodotRM[Godot 限制根运动]
    GodotRM --> Plugin[插件或手动去除根运动]
    UnityRM --> PluginNone[无需插件]
    Animation[动画导入] --> UnityAnim[Unity 可直接导入 T/A Pose]
    Animation --> GodotAnim[Godot 需多步骤识别]
    GodotAnim --> Steps[保存为资源 → 映射 → 唯一实例]
    Steps --> Plugin[可用插件重写文件]
```
